outline: 1844 Finding Unknown Sides Given the Area

examples.question_text:
(a) A square has sides of $1$ cm. Explain why its area is $100\text{ mm}^2$, rather than $10\text{ mm}^2$.
(b) Convert $6.3\text{ cm}^2$ to $\text{mm}^2$.
(c) Convert $4700\text{ cm}^2$ to $\text{m}^2$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Each side is $10$ mm long.
$10\times10=100\text{ mm}^2$.
The length factor is squared because there are two dimensions.
(b) A square millimetre is smaller, so multiply.
$6.3\times10^2=630\text{ mm}^2$.
(c) A square metre is larger, so divide.
$4700\div100^2=4700\div10\,000=0.47\text{ m}^2$.

examples.question_text:
Complete both rows of this area table.
$\begin{array}{c|c|c}\text{m}^2&\text{cm}^2&\text{mm}^2\\\hline0.83&?&?\\?&36\,500&?\end{array}$

(a) Which is larger: $0.73\text{ m}^2$ or $6900\text{ cm}^2$? Give the larger area in $\text{cm}^2$.
(b) A garden bed covers $1.42\text{ m}^2$ and a path beside it covers $3800\text{ cm}^2$. Find their total area in $\text{m}^2$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Use the same unit for both areas.
$0.73\times10\,000=7300\text{ cm}^2$.
$7300>6900$, so the larger area is $7300\text{ cm}^2$.
(b) Convert the path's area before adding.
$3800\div10\,000=0.38\text{ m}^2$.
$1.42+0.38=1.80\text{ m}^2$.

examples.question_text:
(a) A floor has area $39\text{ m}^2$. Tiles each cover $625\text{ cm}^2$ and are sold in boxes of $12$ at $\$17.50$ per box. Find the cost of the tiles needed.
(b) A farm covers $4.6$ ha. Using area alone, how many whole house blocks of $1450\text{ m}^2$ could it contain?
examples.solution_text:
(a) Convert the floor area to the tile unit.
$39\times10\,000=390\,000\text{ cm}^2$.
$390\,000\div625=624$ tiles.
$624\div12=52$ boxes.
$52\times17.50=\$910$.
(b) $4.6\times10\,000=46\,000\text{ m}^2$.
$46\,000\div1450=31.72\ldots$.
By area, there is enough for **$31$ whole blocks**. A further whole block would exceed the farm's area.

examples.question_text:
(a) A property covers $187\,500\text{ m}^2$. Its owner plants $12$ trees per hectare. How many trees are planted?
(b) A park covers $16.8\text{ km}^2$. A ranger patrols $240$ ha each day. How many days are needed to patrol the whole park?
examples.solution_text:
(a) Convert to hectares before using the planting rate.
$187\,500\div10\,000=18.75\text{ ha}$.
$18.75\times12=225$ trees.
(b) $16.8\times100=1680\text{ ha}$.
$1680\div240=7$ days.

examples.question_text:
Convert these areas. For (a) and (b), show the intermediate area in square centimetres.
(a) $0.24\text{ m}^2$ to $\text{mm}^2$.
(b) $720\,000\text{ mm}^2$ to $\text{m}^2$.
(c) $0.032\text{ km}^2$ to $\text{m}^2$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Multiply by the squared length factor at each link.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.24\text{ m}^2\times100^2\\&=2400\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}2400\text{ cm}^2\times10^2\\&=240\,000\text{ mm}^2\end{aligned}$
(b) Divide at each link to a larger unit.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}720\,000\text{ mm}^2\div10^2\\&=7200\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}7200\text{ cm}^2\div100^2\\&=0.72\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$
(c) The length factor is $1000$, so the area factor is $1000^2$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.032\text{ km}^2\times1000^2\\&=32\,000\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$

examples.derivation: Independently calculated: (a) 0.24 × 100² = 2400 cm²; 2400 × 10² = 240000 mm². (b) 720000 ÷ 10² = 7200 cm²; 7200 ÷ 100² = 0.72 m². (c) 0.032 × 1000² = 32000 m². These follow source Foundation Q7–8 using different values. Each relation-led continuation has a phantom equals gutter; no diagram is needed.

Independently derived: (a) 1 m = 100 cm, so 100 × 100 = 10000 cm². (b) 100 × 100 = 10000 m² per hectare. (c) 1000 × 1000 = 1000000 m² per square kilometre. (d) cm² to mm² multiplies by 10² = 100; m² to ha divides by 100² = 10000. The source investigation, hectare definition and conversion ladder support these methods. Both diagrams are consistent unshaded planar squares with black outlines and labels; converted side annotations appear only in the solution.
